root_causes.description: The recommendation service's server-side p99 latency is pinned at the 10000ms histogram ceiling and its request spans run ~15s while reporting zero errors and showing no CPU, memory, or restart anomalies, indicating injected/processing latency within recommendation itself. This latency propagates upstream to frontend, which depends on recommendation, producing the cluster-wide P99 latency watchdog alert.

evidence.observed_value: p99=10000.000ms (pinned at histogram ceiling); mean/p50/p95/p99/max all 10000ms
request_rate mean=0.011, max=0.029 (very low throughput despite long spans)
evidence.expected_baseline: stable request rate; saturation would show elevated concurrency
no memory growth / no OOM pressure

evidence.observed_value: recommendation span user_get_recommendations duration=15000ms, status ok; 20 traces sampled, 0 errors, p95_duration=45011ms
p99=10000.000ms — same ceiling, latency propagated upstream to frontend

root_causes.description: Frontend also shows p99 pinned at the 10000ms ceiling, but as a caller of recommendation its latency is most plausibly a propagated symptom rather than an independent fault; retained only as an alternative if recommendation latency were a downstream observation.

Recommendation depends on product-catalog; a slow product-catalog could block recommendation and produce its pinned latency. However, no independent product-catalog error/latency signal could be isolated, so this remains a lower-probability alternative.

evidence.observed_value: product-catalog search returned 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=16505ms with same 15000ms recommendation spans
evidence.expected_baseline: product-catalog span p95 < 200ms; error-free downstream does not explain pinned 10000ms ceiling

evidence.observed_value: [no logs found] — no error propagation from any downstream
evidence.expected_baseline: dependency failures typically emit error logs

remediation_steps: Scale out the recommendation deployment (increase replicas / CPU-memory headroom) to relieve request handling producing ~15s server spans.
Instrument the recommendation → product-catalog client-span path to confirm whether recommendation is blocked on a slow downstream dependency rather than its own processing.
Inspect recommendation runtime config (e.g. flagd feature flags / injected latency) for a fixed delay pinning p99 at the 10000ms histogram ceiling.
Add latency SLO alerts on recommendation specifically (p99 > 1s) so the fault is attributed at origin rather than only at the frontend/global watchdog level.
